title: Managed disclosure campaign that began in 2017

tellings.quote: I I disagree with Carl Nell quite a bit when he says that his current the the current like carefully managed 2017 originating uh disclosure campaign is kind of dead.

plain: A retired Army colonel named Karl Nell has said that a carefully managed campaign of "disclosure", meaning a gradual official release of what the government knows about UFOs, began in 2017 and is now "kind of dead." A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb tells Michels he disagrees "quite a bit" and thinks the campaign is still going. If he is right, the steady trickle of official UFO news since 2017 is still being planned and released on purpose.
